Hi Maria — thanks for the note and checklist. Quick summary below; attaching a clean pricing sheet and a mapping doc for the checklist.

High-level mapping (see attached Redwood_Compliance_PRICING_v3.pdf):
- Audit logs: 30/90/365 day retention tiers. Monthly uplift: €0.02/GB (30d), €0.05/GB (90d), €0.09/GB (365d). Non-recurring: one-time indexing fee for >30d historical ingest (if needed).
- KMS/HSM: two models — per-seat HSM (one-time provisioning + annual maintenance) or throughput-based envelope KMS (recurring bytes/ops). For EU sovereign customers we typically recommend 2 HSM seats for HA; suggested amortized annual cost per seat: €12,000 (can be blended against committed usage).
- Data residency (EU): +8–12% uplift on hosted inference price dependent on region/availability zone. Includes separate audit log routing and storage scoping.

Onboarding credits proposal for 12-month commit (500k tokens/mo):
- One-time onboarding credit: equivalent of 2 months of committed token consumption applied as invoice credit over first 3 invoices.
- Implementation offset: up to €25k one-time credit against provisioning fees (HSM/KMS provisioning or integration SOW) for a 12-month commit.

Concession cap and staging: Our standard concession cap on non-recurring credits is 25% of first-year ARR for commercial deals of this size; implementation evidence (SOC2 artifacts, HSM attestations) can be staged — we provide SOC2-ready artifacts within 30 days of contract and HSM attestation after provisioning (typically 4–6 weeks).

Next steps: Laura (legal) and Aditya (solutions) are looped in to confirm SOW language and finalize the concession cap wording. If that works we can send a DocuSign-ready SOW + invoice schedule.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_PRICING_v3.pdf (pricing + checklist mapping)

Markus / team,

Thanks — reviewed Markus's proposed structure. A few edits and recommendations for the SOW and concession language:

1) Implementation credit framing: change "applied as invoice credit over first 3 invoices" to "applied as a contra-invoice credit amortized over first 6 invoices" — this prevents a single large drop to ARR in the first month and matches procurement's preference for smoothing.
2) Concession cap: reduce to 20% of first-year ARR but allow an exceptions bucket (requires VP approval) for evidence-heavy deals. Suggest we present the standard offer at 20% and markable up to 25% with approval.
3) HSM attestation timing: update wording to "HSM attestation delivered within 6 weeks of provisioning, evidence gate is 'provisioned and operational' not earlier." This prevents acceptance predicates before keys are live.
4) Audit log retention: include a 'grace ingest' clause — first 30 days of historic ingest waived for onboarding only. Anything beyond billed at the 30d tier rate.

I'll prepare redline SOW snippets and a short concession term we can include in the commercial exhibit. Aditya, can you confirm the technical lead time for provisioning two HSM seats in eu-west-1 (estimate in working days)?

Laura Bennett
Senior Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
